country_event = {
	id = ante_carthage.42
	title = ante_carthage.42.t
	desc = ante_carthage.42.d
	picture = GFX_ante_event_vote
	is_triggered_only = yes
	option = {
		name = ante_carthage.42.a
		ai_chance = { factor = 80 }
		custom_effect_tooltip = CAR_TT_ALLIANCE
		hidden_effect = {
			set_country_flag = CAR_rome_allied
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { ante_realm_states > ROM.ante_realm_states } }
				CAR = {
					if = { limit = { is_in_faction = no } create_faction = ante_faction_rome_and_carthage }
				}
				ROM = {
					if = {
						limit = { is_faction_leader = yes NOT = { is_in_faction_with = CAR } }
						every_country = {
							limit = { is_in_faction_with = ROM NOT = { tag = ROM } }
							ROM = { remove_from_faction = PREV }
							every_country = { limit = { is_faction_leader = yes OR = { tag = CAR is_in_faction_with = CAR } } add_to_faction = PREV }
						}
						dismantle_faction = yes
					}
					if = { limit = { is_in_faction = yes NOT = { is_in_faction_with = CAR } } leave_faction = yes }
				}
				every_country = {
					limit = { is_faction_leader = yes OR = { tag = CAR is_in_faction_with = CAR } NOT = { is_in_faction_with = ROM } }
					add_to_faction = ROM
				}
			}
			else = {
				ROM = {
					if = { limit = { is_in_faction = no } create_faction = ante_faction_rome_and_carthage }
				}
				CAR = {
					if = {
						limit = { is_faction_leader = yes NOT = { is_in_faction_with = ROM } }
						every_country = {
							limit = { is_in_faction_with = CAR NOT = { tag = CAR } }
							CAR = { remove_from_faction = PREV }
							every_country = { limit = { is_faction_leader = yes OR = { tag = ROM is_in_faction_with = ROM } } add_to_faction = PREV }
						}
						dismantle_faction = yes
					}
					if = { limit = { is_in_faction = yes NOT = { is_in_faction_with = ROM } } leave_faction = yes }
				}
				every_country = {
					limit = { is_faction_leader = yes OR = { tag = ROM is_in_faction_with = ROM } NOT = { is_in_faction_with = CAR } }
					add_to_faction = CAR
				}
			}
		}
	}
	option = {
		name = ante_carthage.42.b
		ai_chance = { factor = 20 }
		set_variable = { CAR_rome_relation = 60 }
	}
}
